takeaways.text: Lines up **Inline (tight)** on **74%** of 251 plays (n=185); also Slot 21% (n=53).
Route on **93%** / blocks on **7%** of dropbacks (95% CI 89–95%, n=251) — 6 pts above the TE average of 86%.
From **SINGLEBACK** (formation), route rate is **74%** (CI 60–84%, n=46) — less likely to run a route than his overall 93%.

Because he releases into a route on ~93% of dropbacks and most often from Inline (tight), a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.
